question: In the preserved S17 whole-module context, does a used zero draw argument initialized before pointer-fixup loops retain the extra frame word and reproduce the original spill homes?
notes: Context-specific. The draw local is used by the existing menu setup call; no folded artificial read or padding declaration is added.
int, unsigned and unsigned-char draw types match; original type, spelling and exact source placement are not recovered. The accepted target is layout-inferred.
